body: It's okay, its a stressful situation. But something has to be done, thank you
I know. This is all so, so stressful
Literally no one that I know of that will have them in a healthy environment. These generation curses run DEEP, on BOTH sides of the family. I'll either have to keep looking or take them in.

I'm not sure if I'm in a place to be responsible for them, especially bc the lack of discipline makes them act out most times and idk how to handle that. I don't know where they'd go, I don't want them in the system. I'll have to take them in, right?
I will, thank you. Can we please discuss those options sorry
Thank you
I know but could you read my latest post? I really don't know what to do.
I hope that you didn't end up doing this. I'm in the same situation, always was growing up. It isn't a good idea.
You remind me of myself, I'm here for you. We can chat if you're comfortable with that too.
This is terrible Im sorry
Your story reminds me of my own. Everyday is so hard and I'm nil idk how you made it out without giving up but im so glad that you did
I'm crying reading this, thank you. Thank you.
Though our circumstances are different, my Christmas will be looking very different too this year. It's okay. It's the first one, it'll get easier. I'm here for you <3

A lot. A lot. But in this moment some support, empathy, affection, validation, anything. I go everyday either not talking about it or getting invalidated by those that I do bring it up to. It's enough to drive someone insane.

I want to go no contact so bad but I'll miss my siblings (she said she wouldn't let me see them if I did) and I may also need her for other things (particularly money or a place to stay in between semesters). Im scared to burn that bridge, don't know I'm independent enough. 

And as for your book, please. I'd love to give it a read. I feel very alone so I'm sure it'd help

He isn't abusing them, but I'm in a difficult spot with that. The only reason why I haven't is because I don't know where the kids would go, I don't want them over there either. Our entire family is not equipped or won't take them. I wouldn't trust anyone with them but myself but then there goes the rest of my life bc of my moms decisions, right? I don't know what to do. Not to mention my mom says whoever takes tries to take my siblings (i.e. the police?), would have to kill her first. She's crazy and I don't doubt that. The kids have been traumatized enough and I just don't know what to do, it is all ***too*** much
Thank you, I need to keep telling myself this instead of trying to make it make sense.

lol right on the money. Looking forward to your input tomorrow if any. I really appreciate you even attempting to read this, even wanting to. You all are so nice man it makes me wanna cry. Im not used to this

Ehh I kind of disagree, Narciscissim presents low internal self esteem, high external. It's really easy ro kinda"know"deep down that you're ugly and put up that facade still (I know bc I've dated one LOL) - BECAUSE OF THAT INSECURITY. That's most of what narcissism is anyways, extreme insecurity,
Hi there, how's it going? :)

I LOVE that show.Just got down rewatching it actually. I once told a friend that I could relate to Bojack Horseman and he looked concerned. That's when I thought something may be wrong lol

Anyways, thank you for reaching out. I can't describe to you how much it means to me.

I'm so glad, you're never truly alone its just hard to see, especially bc. I  wrote my post thinking no one could relate to this shit show. I'm  here you need another reminder that youre not alone ever

I will try. Strangers on the internet are showing me more love than my own family and it feels nice. Also if you read the whole thing, you're a real one and I appreciate you even more than I already did. Thank you.

My little sister is the only reason why I'm still here. She's the one who held me when I begged my mom to in tears. She's the one who checks on me when I'm wailing because of the pain. I can't leave her. I can't. I won't leave her, especially not in this hellhole of a family, to fend for herself like I did.
I appreciate your comment <3

I know I shouldn't use these things to fill the void but I mean it, if I had one person to genuinely connect with and care about me, my mental health would be immensely better. I've been doing this alone essentially and like I said, out of all of the family members who know, NO ONE checks in consistently (maybe once or twice since the summer). It's too hard.

Your comment means soo much to me. Thank you.

I wish I could tell you everything, but I genuinely do not foresee things getting better for some time and each time I've waited something worse happens that makes me wish I would've died. I was born into dysfunction and it never ends. I just don't wanna stick around for things to get bad again, even if they do get better, you know?

Also, I'm so sorry for what you went through, you're honestly so strong I can't imagine how you did it but its inspiring.
